##Current shipping forecast##

##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

High pressure to the west of Ireland extending a ridge across the Irish Sea area.


##Wind##

Northwest 3 to 5, increasing 5 or 6 in the North Channel this afternoon, then more widely this evening, decreasing 3 to 5 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Mainly slight, soon becoming slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##
